2609.01383.title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
2609.01383.paper_summary: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.
2609.01383.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型在解釋靜態視覺物件方面展現了卓越的能力，但現代數據分析本質上是動態的，要求對互動環境進行主動詢問。現有的基準主要局限於靜態影像和一次性問題回答，未能捕捉到這一領域的認識需求，在這裡，證據經常被遮蔽、分佈在連結的視圖中，或通過用戶的行為條件性地揭示。在本文中，我們介紹了 InSight，一個針對互動視覺化的主動聲明驗證基準。該數據集由 21,349 條來自人類撰寫的分析敘事的聲明組成，並基於完全互動的網絡環境。代理必須在這些環境中導航，以確定自然語言聲明是否得到支持、被駁斥或在可用證據下無法驗證。與傳統評估不同，InSight 將互動痕跡視為推理的內在代理，從而使模型尋求和綜合視覺證據的過程進行嚴格審計。我們評估了最先進的模型，揭示互動驗證仍然是一個非平凡的挑戰。我們在 https://github.com/maevehutch/insight 上發布了 InSight。
